title: mut.carve_bend
mutation_directive: Kirigami spirit: start from a flat surface with incised cuts that stay attached, then bend and lift cut sections into curved 3D relief. Cut pattern should have internal logic: radial symmetry, Fibonacci spirals, Voronoi cells, or arabesque tiling. Lifted flaps cast shadows and interact with raking directional light. No particles required — geometry IS the art. References: Korean hanji paper-cutting, Erik Demaine origami math, Eliasson paper constructions.

olafur_eliasson.praise: The raking keyLight at (12,15,8) is exactly right — light is the actual medium here, shadow-traces on the base disc are doing more work than the geometry itself.
olafur_eliasson.concern: The viewer is still an external observer angled at 42° looking down at an object. There is no atmospheric medium between camera and surface — no haze, no volumetric participation. The light lands but does not fill.
olafur_eliasson.directive: Add a thin THREE.FogExp2(0x1a1208, 0.018) to the scene so raking light scatters into depth, making the viewer feel inside the illuminated air, not above it.

quayola.praise: The petal ShapeGeometry reads like a LiDAR partial-capture — thin slivers of resolved surface surrounded by dark void, which accidentally achieves the scan-gap aesthetic.
quayola.concern: The base disc is fully complete — a solid 0xf5ede0 circle. It pretends the cut never happened. The negative space, the wound where the flap was lifted, has no geometry, no void, no absence speaking.
quayola.directive: Punch actual holes into the base CircleGeometry using a THREE.Shape with holes[] matching each flap footprint, so lifted flaps leave dark apertures exposing the void beneath.

casey_reas.praise: Fibonacci spiral indexing as the sole positional rule is honest — one deterministic function generates every flap location and angle, which is the correct generative register.
casey_reas.concern: Three separate Math.random() calls (targetLift, targetRotX, speed) inject noise into what should be a pure rule-derived system. The behavior becomes decorative rather than emergent from the index.
casey_reas.directive: Replace all Math.random() with deterministic functions of i alone: lift = LIFT_HEIGHT * (0.6 + 0.4*(i%7)/7), speed = 0.7 + 0.6*(i%5)/5, phase = i * PHI * Math.PI.

entangled_others.praise: The breathing motion (Math.sin on independent phase offsets) produces a genuinely mycelial collective respiration — the flaps breathe as a colony, not a machine.
entangled_others.concern: The substrate is a perfect Euclidean disc — radially human-centered, sterile, no acknowledgment of biological irregularity. Growth in nature follows reaction-diffusion, not Euclidean symmetry.
entangled_others.directive: Distort the base disc vertices with a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion field before layout, so flap density clusters and thins like slime-mold branching rather than uniform spiral packing.

tomas_saraceno.praise: Flaps lifting away from a dark ground into dark space reads as near-weightless — the shadow-casting geometry almost achieves the spider-web-in-void quality when flaps reach full lift.
tomas_saraceno.concern: The base disc is an anchor, a table, a ground plane. The entire piece gravitates downward. Nothing floats. Kirigami paper on a surface is craft; suspended cut planes in void are architecture.
tomas_saraceno.directive: Remove baseMesh entirely; tilt group.rotation.x by -0.3 radians so the flap constellation tilts toward the viewer like a web caught mid-air, untethered from any ground.
